title: SI Core Engine
text: Spark-ignition engine from intake to exhaust port, 9 inputs, 4 outputs, {Torque table load breakpoints, f_tq_nl_l_bpt} sets Breakpoints [0.2 0.275 0.35 0.425 0.5 0.575 0.65 0.725 0.8 0.875 0.95 1.025 1.1 1.175; {Air mass flow model} selects air mass flow model Dual-Independent Variable Cam, {Torque model} selects torque model, {Number of cylinders, NCyl} sets the engine cylinders, {Crank revolutions per power stroke, Cps} sets the revolutions per stroke, {Total displaced volume, Vd} sets the volume, {Ideal gas constant air, Rair} sets the constant, {Air standard pressure, Pstd} sets the pressure, {Air standard temperature, Tstd} sets the temperature, {Speed-density volumetric efficiency, f_nv} sets the lookup table array, {Speed-density intake manifold pressure breakpoints, f_nv_prs_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Speed-density engine speed breakpoints, f_nv_n_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Cylinder volume at intake valve close table, f_vivc} sets the 2-D lookup table array, {Cylinder volume intake cam phase breakpoints, f_vivc_icp_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Cylinder trapped mass correction factor, f_tm_corr} sets the lookup table array, {Normalized density breakpoints, f_tm_corr_nd_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Engine speed breakpoints, f_tm_corr_n_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Intake mass flow, f_mdot_intk} sets the lookup table array, {Exhaust cam phase breakpoints, f_mdot_air_ecp_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Trapped mass flow breakpoints, f_mdot_trpd_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Air mass flow correction factor, f_mdot_air_corr} sets the lookup table array, {Engine load breakpoints for air mass flow correction, f_mdot_air_corr_ld_bpt} sets the breakpoints vector, {Engine speed breakpoints for air mass flow correction, f_mdot_air_n_bpt} sets the breakpoints vector, {Torque table, f_tq_nl} sets the lookup table, {Torque table speed breakpoints, f_tq_nl_n_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Crank angle pressure and torque} enables Crank angle signals, {Cylinder pressure, f_crk_prs} sets the cylinder pressure table L x M x, {Brake torque, f_crk_btq} sets the brake torque table L x M x, {Speed breakpoints, f_crk_n_bpt} sets the speed breakpoints, {Load breakpoints, f_crk_l_bpt} sets the load breakpoints, {Crank angle breakpoints, f_crk_ang_bpt} sets the crank angle breakpoints, {TDC compression angles by cylinder, f_crk_tdc_ang} sets the tDC compression angles by cylinder, {Inner torque table, f_tq_inr} sets the lookup table array, {Friction torque table, f_tq_fric} sets the lookup table array, {Engine temperature modifier on friction torque, f_fric_temp_mod} sets the lookup table, {Engine temperature modifier breakpoints, f_fric_temp_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Pumping torque table, f_tq_pump} sets the lookup table array, {Optimal spark table, f_sa_opt} sets the lookup table array, {Inner torque load breakpoints, f_tq_inr_l_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Inner torque speed breakpoints, f_tq_inr_n_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Spark efficiency table, f_m_sa} sets the lookup table array, {Spark retard from optimal, f_del_sa_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Lambda efficiency, f_m_lam} sets the lookup table array, {Lambda breakpoints, f_m_lam_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Exhaust temperature table, f_t_exh} sets the lookup table array, {Load breakpoints, f_t_exh_l_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Speed breakpoints, f_t_exh_n_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Exhaust gas specific heat at constant pressure, cp_exh} sets the specific heat, {CO2 mass fraction table, f_CO2_frac} sets the carbon dioxide, {CO mass fraction table, f_CO_frac} sets the carbon monoxide, {HC mass fraction table, f_HC_frac} sets the hydrocarbon, {NOx mass fraction table, f_NOx_frac} sets the nitric oxide and nitrogen dioxide, {PM mass fraction table, f_PM_frac} sets the particulate matter, {Engine speed breakpoints, f_exhfrac_n_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Engine torque breakpoints, f_exhfrac_trq_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Injector slope, Sinj} sets the slope, {Stoichiometric air-fuel ratio, afr_stoich} sets the air-fuel ratio, {Fuel lower heating value, fuel_lhv} sets the heating value 46e6 and {Fuel specific gravity, fuel_sg} sets the specific gravity. Values come from the instance.
